_comment: Per-config frame budgets, p95 over a telemetry run (RTX 2060, 1280x720). Measured 2026-10-31 at load ~7-15, so every budget carries ~1.5-2x headroom over the measured p95; a canary firing on a loaded machine means re-run at low load before blaming the change. min_coverage: gpu timestamp queries must resolve on >=90% of frames (first two frames never resolve: slot arming). Wall (total_us) is present-bound (~10ms) except physics scenes, where the CPU solver step dominates -- that cost is D1's, budgeted here only as observed.
